cohort: 32,651 children from the Danish National Birth Cohort (1996-2002)
finding: Antibiotic exposure during mid-to-late pregnancy was associated with higher odds of childhood asthma in children born vaginally, but not in those born by cesarean section.
mod_finding: The association between antibiotic exposure during pregnancy and childhood asthma was only observed in vaginally born children, with no association found in children born via planned or emergency cesarean section.
